title: 봄비 우산 수리점
description: 봄비가 내리는 아늑한 우산 수리점에서 다섯 가지 차이를 찾아보세요.
scene: A cozy whimsical umbrella repair shop during a gentle spring rain, viewed from inside at eye level. The scene includes a large arched window with raindrops and a quiet cobblestone lane outside, a wooden workbench, six clearly separated colorful umbrellas in a wall rack, a pair of yellow rain boots, three large thread spools, a brass hand-crank sewing machine, a ceramic teapot, a sleeping gray cat on a round cushion, a hanging glass lamp, and small potted spring flowers. Keep every prop large, distinct, and spatially separated for a spot-the-difference puzzle
style: premium whimsical storybook illustration, fresh mint green, rain blue, coral, and warm honey wood palette, crisp object silhouettes, richly detailed but uncluttered
changeGuidance: Make exactly these five localized changes only: change one coral umbrella canopy to violet; remove the buckle from the left yellow rain boot; change the center thread spool from blue to orange; add a small teal bow collar to the gray cat; remove the teapot lid. Preserve every other object, raindrop, flower, reflection, camera angle, and lighting exactly
